topic: Engineering Value - The Importance of Creating & Identifying Value in the World of Chemical Engineering
title: Engineering Value - The Importance of Creating & Identifying Value in the World of Chemical Engineering
session_title: Engineering Value - The Importance of Creating & Identifying Value in the World of Chemical Engineering
abstract: Are you ready to take your chemical engineering skills to the next level? The ability to identify and understand the value of various chemical engineering tasks is such an important skill in industry. Being able to properly justify the benefits of a capital project, process optimization study, or incident investigation can lead to much higher rates of success. Join us for a seminar on understanding various types of value creation and how to determine the qualitative and/or quantitative value to a company in your chemical engineering work.
